name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are visible, so I can only reason about design. All 9 trials ran without errors. r3c2 (about 400k steps) shows that 1 PPO epoch with 512 envs fits within the time limit. Three ideas have each been tried at 2 or 3 epochs but never with 1 epoch: per-layer landing heads, cell attention, and more samples per unit of compute. Since this is the last round, I will put these ideas together rather than open new directions. A and B test whether attention or the landing head works best with lots of samples at 1 epoch. C combines both modules at 2 epochs, which hedges in case 1 epoch is too few gradient steps. For the 1-epoch runs I use 32 minibatches instead of 16, which doubles the gradient steps per update compared with r3c2.
